links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT grading category across repeated responses to the same question
links.effect: Overall reproducibility was high at 95.2% (100/105); lower for heterogeneous domains such as neurodevelopmental delay and epilepsy.

links.outcome: Accuracy and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT answers to pediatric neurology caregiver questions, rated by two neurologists
links.effect: 60.95% (64/105) comprehensive; 31.43% (33/105) correct but incomplete; 3.8% (4/105) fully incorrect.
links.quote: 60.95%(64/105) of responses were rated as comprehensive, while 31.43%(33/105) were correct but incomplete; fully incorrect responses were uncommon 3.8%(4/105).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and reproducibility of ChatGPT responses to caregiver questions in pediatric neurology using expert ratings.
